 Singapore vs. Paraguay Lineups, Preview
 Originally posted on
 Athlon Sports 
  | 
 By Pragjyoti Singh
  | 
 Last updated Nov 13, 2026 5:45 AM ET
 Add us as a preferred source on Google
 Singapore host Paraguay in an international friendly today at the National Stadium in Kallang. This is the opening match of the inaugural Mizuho Blue Challenge, with Paraguay looking to test themselves against Asian opposition as they begin their November international tour.
 There is a massive gap in the rankings between the two sides, and the South American nation enters the contest as favorites, sitting 33rd in the FIFA rankings compared to Singapore’s 149th place. 
 PHILADELPHIA, PENNSYLVANIA – JULY 04: Paraguay players pose for a team photograph before the FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 16 match against France.Justin Setterfield / Getty Images
 Gustavo Alfaro’s side will face Japan in their next friendly on November 17 and hence will look to make the most of today’s fixture.
 Singapore vs. Paraguay Lineups
 Singapore expected lineup:
 Mahbud; Pereira, Harun, Baharudin, Stewart; Kweh, Shahiran, Nakamura, Nakamura, Song, Fandi 
 Paraguay expected lineup: 
 Gill; Caceres, Gomez, Alderete, Alonso; Villasanti, Galarza, Bobadilla; Almiron, Benitez, Enciso
 What Time Does Singapore vs. Paraguay Start? 
 Singapore: 8 p.m. SGT, November 13
 Paraguay: 9 a.m. PYST, November 13
 USA: 7 a.m. EST / 4 a.m. PST, November 13
 Canada: 7 a.m. EST, November 13
 UK: 12 p.m. GMT, November 13
 Europe: 1 p.m. CET, November 13
 West Africa: 1 p.m. WAT, November 13
 Central Africa: 2 p.m. CAT, November 13
 East Africa: 3 p.m. EAT, November 13
 Australia: 11 p.m. AEDT, November 13
 How to Watch Singapore vs. Paraguay? TV Channels & Live Streaming 
 Singapore: meWATCH and meWATCH Sports. The match will be available through the platform’s sports coverage.
 Paraguay: GEN and El Trece on television; VS Sports on YouTube and the official APF TV app for live streaming.
 Japan: U-NEXT.
 USA: No confirmed official TV or streaming broadcaster.
